Only 23% of 4,441 remote listings reveal pay. Here's what that means for your job search.

Our latest data shows that out of 4,441 active remote listings, just 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The rest—3,441 listings (77%)—keep compensation private. That challenges the idea that remote jobs are always upfront about pay.

But here's the good news: 2,753 listings (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world. So even if pay isn't listed, you can still find roles that fit your skills and location.

What skills are in demand? Communication tops the list (39% of 4,282 analyzed listings), followed by AI (12%), leadership (10%), sales (8%), project management (7%), and data analysis (7%). AI is growing fast—12% of listings now require it.

Companies like Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether are hiring remotely. Only Neo Financial discloses pay ($5 USD/hour for bilingual client services).

Want to find roles that pay in USD and are open worldwide? Use Loker Dollar's filter for 'worldwide remote' to see the 2,753 listings accepting any location.

Read the full breakdown: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
